description: Foundation layer: install async-storage dependency, rewrite the API client (src/services/api.js), create all utility and hook files (storage, formatters, useAsync), create all feature hooks (useProducts, useOrders, useCart), update appStore with auth state and AsyncStorage persistence, and add i18n keys for auth UI. These files are all independent of each other and of FEAT-002/003 except that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 import from them.
steps: Step 1 — Add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/package.json dependencies with exact pinned version '2.1.2' (latest compatible with Expo SDK ~57). Run `npm install` in d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile to install it.

Step 2 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/utils/storage.js. Export six named functions: getToken(), setToken(token), removeToken() using key 'formo_access_token'; getRefreshToken(), setRefreshToken(token), removeRefreshToken() using key 'formo_refresh_token'; plus generic getItem(key), setItem(key, value), removeItem(key). All use @react-native-async-storage/async-storage. All are async. Handle errors silently (catch returns null/undefined).

Step 3 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/utils/formatters.js. Export: formatMoney(value, currency) — formats as '289 000 so'm' using toLocaleString('uz-UZ'); matches the existing formatMoney in Common.js but accepts optional currency arg defaulting to "so'm". formatDate(dateString) — parses ISO or DD.MM.YYYY strings and returns DD.MM.YYYY format. formatPhone(phone) — normalizes to '+998 XX XXX XX XX' display format.

Step 4 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/hooks/useAsync.js. Export default useAsync(asyncFn, deps). Returns { data, isLoading, error, execute, reset }. On mount (and when deps change) calls execute() automatically. execute() sets isLoading=true, calls asyncFn(), sets data on success or error on failure, always sets isLoading=false. reset() clears data and error. deps array follows React useMemo/useEffect semantics.

Step 5 — Rewrite d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/services/api.js from scratch. BASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'https://api.formo.uz/api'. Internal async request(path, options) function: reads token from storage.getToken(), adds 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header if token exists, adds 'Content-Type: application/json' header, calls fetch(BASE_URL+path, mergedOptions), on 401 calls storage.removeToken() + storage.removeRefreshToken() (logout signal) then throws an AuthError, on other non-ok status throws Error with status code, returns response.json(). Export named 'api' object with methods: auth.login(phone, password) POST /auth/login returns {accessToken, refreshToken, user}; auth.register(fullName, phone, password) POST /auth/register returns {accessToken, refreshToken, user}; auth.me() GET /auth/me returns user object; auth.logout() POST /auth/logout; products.list() GET /products (will 404 — caller handles); orders.list() GET /orders (will 404 — caller handles); orders.create(payload) POST /orders; orders.get(id) GET /orders/:id. Do NOT call storage inside feature hooks — only the request() helper and auth methods touch storage.

Step 6 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/features/products/index.js. Export default useProducts() hook. On mount: calls api.products.list(), on success sets products state from response, on any error (including 404 network error) falls back to imported mock products from '../../data/mockData'. Returns { products, isLoading, error, refetch }. refetch() re-runs the fetch. Never throws to the caller.

Step 7 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/features/orders/index.js. Export default useOrders() hook. On mount: calls api.orders.list(), on success sets orders state, on any error falls back to mock orders from '../../data/mockData'. Returns { orders, isLoading, error, createOrder(payload), refetch }. createOrder(payload) calls api.orders.create(payload), on success prepends the returned order to local state; on error throws to the caller (so CartScreen can show an inline error). refetch() re-runs list(). Never throws on the initial load.

Step 8 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/features/cart/index.js. Export default useCart(store) hook that wraps the store's cart/addToCart/removeFromCart/clearCart with a checkout(deliveryData) method. checkout() builds an order payload from store.cart + deliveryData, calls api.orders.create(payload), on success clears the cart and returns the created order object. On any error, rethrows so the CartScreen can display an inline error message. Returns { cart: store.cart, addToCart: store.addToCart, removeFromCart: store.removeFromCart, clearCart: store.clearCart, total (computed sum of cart item prices), checkout }.

Step 9 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/store/appStore.js. Add: isAuthenticated (bool, default false), user (object|null, default null), setUser(user)/clearUser() setters. On language change call storage.setItem('formo_language', code). On mount read 'formo_language' from storage and init language state (via useEffect + storage.getItem). Keep all existing exports (cart, favorites, addToCart, removeFromCart, toggleFavorite, clearCart, language, setLanguage). Export useAppStore as before.

Step 10 — Add new i18n keys to d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/i18n/index.js for all three language dictionaries (uz, ru, en). New keys to add: login, register, phone, password, confirmPassword, fullName, loginButton, registerButton, loginError, networkError, loggingIn, registering, noAccount, haveAccount, welcome, welcomeSub, logoutConfirm, deleteConfirm, deleteAccountConfirmSub, confirmQuestion, authError. Values: uz='Kirish/Ro'yxatdan o'tish/Telefon/Parol/Parolni tasdiqlang/To'liq ism/Kirish/Ro'yxatdan o'tish/Telefon yoki parol noto'g'ri/Tarmoq xatosi/Kirilmoqda.../Ro'yxatdan o'tilmoqda.../Akkauntingiz yo'qmi?/Akkauntingiz bormi?/Xush kelibsiz/Formo ga qaytib keling/Chiqishni tasdiqlaysizmi?/O'chirishni tasdiqlaysizmi?/Bu amal qaytarib bo'lmaydi/Tasdiqlash?/Kirish xatosi'; ru='Войти/Регистрация/Телефон/Пароль/Подтвердите пароль/Полное имя/Войти/Зарегистрироваться/Неверный телефон или пароль/Ошибка сети/Вход.../Регистрация.../Нет аккаунта?/Уже есть аккаунт?/Добро пожаловать/Рады вас видеть в Formo/Выйти из аккаунта?/Удалить аккаунт?/Это действие нельзя отменить/Подтвердить?/Ошибка входа'; en='Login/Register/Phone/Password/Confirm password/Full name/Login/Register/Wrong phone or password/Network error/Logging in.../Registering.../No account?/Have an account?/Welcome/Good to see you at Formo/Log out?/Delete account?/This cannot be undone/Confirm?/Login error'.
acceptance_criteria: npm install in mobile/ succeeds and @react-native-async-storage/async-storage appears in node_modules
src/utils/storage.js exists and exports getToken, setToken, removeToken, getRefreshToken, setRefreshToken, removeRefreshToken, getItem, setItem, removeItem
src/utils/formatters.js exists and exports formatMoney, formatDate, formatPhone
src/hooks/useAsync.js exists and exports a default useAsync function
src/services/api.js exports an 'api' object with auth.login, auth.register, auth.me, auth.logout, products.list, orders.list, orders.create, orders.get methods
src/features/products/index.js, src/features/orders/index.js, src/features/cart/index.js all exist and export default hooks
src/store/appStore.js exports isAuthenticated, user, setUser, clearUser in addition to existing exports
src/i18n/index.js contains all 22 new keys in all 3 language dicts
npm run export:android in mobile/ completes with exit code 0 (no Metro errors)
findings: COMPLETED. All acceptance criteria met. Verified via `npm run export:android` — Metro bundled 634 modules with exit code 0. Key facts for FEAT-002/003: (1) api.js exports named `api` object + named class `AuthError`; (2) storage.js exports 9 named functions (getToken, setToken, removeToken, getRefreshToken, setRefreshToken, removeRefreshToken, getItem, setItem, removeItem); (3) appStore now exports isAuthenticated (bool), user (object|null), setUser(userData), clearUser() in addition to all pre-existing fields; (4) useProducts default export from src/features/products/index.js, useOrders from src/features/orders/index.js, useCart(store) from src/features/cart/index.js; (5) useCart(store) takes the whole store object as argument; (6) i18n keys are plain JS string values (mix of single and double quotes used to handle apostrophes in Uzbek values); (7) @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 2.1.2 is installed and in node_modules; (8) scripts/inject-i18n.js helper script created and can be deleted.
